english: Permaculture gardens at work: maize, fruit, mulched beds, a home run on solar power and a harvest of vegetables.
before: Permakultuurtuine aan die werk: mielies, vrugte, bedding met deklaag, 'n huis wat op sonkrag loop en 'n oes groente.
back_translation: Permaculture gardens at work: maize, fruit, beds with a covering layer (mulch), a house that runs on solar power and a harvest of vegetables.

english: A base map: an illustrated view of the property with contour lines, the buildings and a north arrow. Map what is already there before you plan anything new.
before: 'n Basiskaart: 'n geïllustreerde aansig van die eiendom met kontoerlyne, die geboue en 'n noordpyltjie. Karteer wat reeds daar is voordat jy enigiets nuuts beplan.
back_translation: A base map: an illustrated view of the property with contour lines, the buildings and a north arrow. Map what is already there before you plan anything new.

english: A family draws their farm plan together. Plan on paper first: a mistake on paper costs nothing to fix.
before: 'n Gesin teken hul plaasplan saam. Beplan eers op papier: 'n fout op papier kos niks om reg te maak nie.
back_translation: A family draws their farm plan together. Plan on paper first: a mistake on paper costs nothing to fix.

english: The same property divided into zones, from the home (Zone 0) out to the wild area (Zone 5). The places you visit every day are closest to the house.
before: Dieselfde eiendom in sones verdeel, van die huis (Sone 0) tot by die wilde gebied (Sone 5). Die plekke wat jy elke dag besoek, is die naaste aan die huis.
back_translation: The same property divided into zones, from the house (Zone 0) to the wild area (Zone 5). The places you visit every day are closest to the house.

english: Zones as rings around the home: the house is Zone 0, and each zone further out is visited less often.
before: Sones as ringe om die huis: die huis is Sone 0, en elke sone verder uit word minder dikwels besoek.
back_translation: Zones as rings around the house: the house is Zone 0, and each zone further out is visited less often.

english: Slope planning: water stored high up, trees on the steep upper slope, the house and gardens lower down, and greywater flowing on down to trees.
before: Hellingbeplanning: water word hoog bo gestoor, bome staan op die steil boonste helling, die huis en tuine is laer af, en gryswater vloei verder af na bome.
back_translation: Slope planning: water is stored high up, trees stand on the steep upper slope, the house and gardens are lower down, and greywater flows further down to trees.

english: A sector map of the same property: hot and cold winds, fire risk, the best view and cold air flowing downhill at night. The small inset shows the sun's path across the north.
before: 'n Sektorkaart van dieselfde eiendom: warm en koue winde, brandgevaar, die beste uitsig en koue lug wat snags afwaarts vloei. Die klein insetsel wys die son se pad oor die noorde.
back_translation: A sector map of the same property: warm and cold winds, fire danger, the best view and cold air that flows downhill at night. The small inset shows the sun's path across the north.

english: Finding north with a compass. In South Africa the needle points about 20 to 28 degrees west of true north.
before: Noord vind met 'n kompas. In Suid-Afrika wys die naald ongeveer 20 tot 28 grade wes van ware noord.
back_translation: Find north with a compass. In South Africa the needle points about 20 to 28 degrees west of true north.

english: The sun is in the north: high in the summer sky and low in winter, so winter shadows are much longer.
before: Die son is in die noorde: hoog in die somerlug en laag in die winter, so winterskaduwees is baie langer.
back_translation: The sun is in the north: high in the summer sky and low in winter, so winter shadows are much longer.

english: On still, clear nights cold air flows downhill and settles in low places. Leave a gap on the downhill side of a hedge so it can drain away.
before: Op stil, helder nagte vloei koue lug afwaarts en bly in lae plekke lê. Laat 'n gaping aan die afhelling-kant van 'n heining sodat dit kan wegdreineer.
back_translation: On still, clear nights cold air flows downhill and stays lying in low places. Leave a gap on the downhill side of a fence so that it can drain away.
note: Hedge came back as 'fence' (heining); meaning intact.

english: A kitchen garden right beside the house, under a shade-net frame. It is the garden you pass many times a day (Zone 1).
before: 'n Kombuistuin reg langs die huis, onder 'n skadunetraam. Dis die tuin wat jy baie kere per dag verbyloop (Sone 1).
back_translation: A kitchen garden right next to the house, under a shade-net frame. It is the garden you walk past many times a day (Zone 1).

english: A mandala garden: beds edged with timber offcuts curve around a central sitting place. A kitchen garden can be useful and beautiful.
before: 'n Mandalatuin: beddings met hout-afsnyselrande draai om 'n sitplek in die middel. 'n Kombuistuin kan nuttig en mooi wees.
back_translation: A mandala garden: beds with edges of wood offcuts wind around a seat in the middle. A kitchen garden can be useful and beautiful.

english: Keyhole beds edged with recycled plastic strip, with stone paths and drip irrigation. You can reach every plant from the path.
before: Sleutelgatbeddings met rande van herwinde plastiekstrook, met klippaadjies en drupbesproeiing. Jy kan elke plant van die paadjie af bykom.
back_translation: Keyhole beds with edges of recycled plastic strip, with stone paths and drip irrigation. You can reach every plant from the path.

english: Stone-edged vegetable beds of spinach and beetroot inside a fence. The paths let you work without stepping on the beds.
before: Groentebeddings met klipwande vol spinasie en beet binne 'n heining. Die paadjies laat jou werk sonder om op die beddings te trap.
back_translation: Vegetable beds with stone walls full of spinach and beetroot inside a fence. The paths let you work without stepping on the beds.

english: A home vegetable garden with mulched rows of cabbage, a short walk from the house (Zone 2).
before: 'n Groentetuin by die huis met rye kool onder deklaag, 'n kort entjie van die huis af (Sone 2).
back_translation: A vegetable garden by the house with rows of cabbage under mulch, a short distance from the house (Zone 2).

english: A market garden: long rows of one crop each, here green and red cabbage, make planting, weeding and harvesting quick.
before: 'n Markgroentetuin: lang rye van een gewas elk, hier groen en rooi kool, maak plant, skoffel en oes vinnig.
back_translation: A market vegetable garden: long rows of one crop each, here green and red cabbage, make planting, hoeing and harvesting fast.

english: Two market-garden blocks seen from above. Beds of the same size make it easy to plan how much to plant and sell.
before: Twee markgroentetuin-blokke van bo af gesien. Beddings van dieselfde grootte maak dit maklik om te beplan hoeveel om te plant en te verkoop.
back_translation: Two market-garden blocks seen from above. Beds of the same size make it easy to plan how much to plant and to sell.

english: A tall, healthy stand of maize in a staple garden. Staple crops need a lot of space, so they go in Zone 3.
before: 'n Hoë, gesonde stand mielies in 'n stapelvoedseltuin. Stapelgewasse het baie ruimte nodig, so hulle gaan in Sone 3.
back_translation: A tall, healthy stand of maize in a staple-food garden. Staple crops need a lot of space, so they go in Zone 3.

english: A chicken's needs, products and behaviours: what it needs (food, water, shelter, grit, dust), what it gives (eggs, meat, manure, feathers) and what it does by nature (scratching, pecking).
before: 'n Hoender se behoeftes, produkte en gedrag: wat dit nodig het (kos, water, skuiling, korrels, stof), wat dit gee (eiers, vleis, mis, vere) en wat dit van nature doen (krap, pik).
back_translation: A chicken's needs, products and behaviour: what it needs (food, water, shelter, grains/pellets(?), dust), what it gives (eggs, meat, manure, feathers) and what it does naturally (scratch, peck).
after: 'n Hoender se behoeftes, produkte en gedrag: wat dit nodig het (kos, water, skuiling, gruis, stof), wat dit gee (eiers, vleis, mis, vere) en wat dit van nature doen (krap, pik).
note: 'korrels' means grains or pellets, so a farmer reads grain feed instead of grit; now 'gruis', the chapter's own word for the small hard stones a hen swallows.

english: Movable poultry pens (animal tractors) on grass. Move them every few days so the birds get fresh ground and the grass can recover.
before: Verskuifbare pluimveehokke (diertrekkers) op gras. Skuif hulle elke paar dae sodat die voëls vars grond kry en die gras kan herstel.
back_translation: Movable poultry houses (animal tractors) on grass. Move them every few days so that the birds get fresh ground and the grass can recover.

english: An A-frame chicken tractor: a light wooden frame with wire mesh, a tin roof for shade and rain, and a drinker inside.
before: 'n A-raam-hoendertrekker: 'n ligte houtraam met draadgaas, 'n sinkdak vir skaduwee en reën, en 'n drinkbak binne-in.
back_translation: An A-frame chicken tractor: a light wooden frame with wire mesh, a zinc roof for shade and rain, and a drinking trough inside.

english: A solar energiser powers movable electric netting around a poultry run: an open animal tractor that you can shift across the land.
before: 'n Sonkrag-energiseerder voorsien krag aan verskuifbare elektriese nette om 'n pluimveehok: 'n oop diertrekker wat jy oor die land kan skuif.
back_translation: A solar energiser supplies power to movable electric nets around a poultry house: an open animal tractor that you can move across the land.

english: Young pigs eating spoiled apricots. Pigs turn fallen and spoiled fruit into meat and manure.
before: Jong varke eet bedorwe appelkose. Varke verander gevalle en bedorwe vrugte in vleis en mis.
back_translation: Young pigs eat spoiled apricots. Pigs turn fallen and spoiled fruit into meat and manure.

english: A pig tractor: pigs graze inside an electric fence powered by a small solar panel, with a simple shelter for shade.
before: 'n Varktrekker: varke wei binne 'n elektriese heining wat deur 'n klein sonpaneel aangedryf word, met 'n eenvoudige skuiling vir skaduwee.
back_translation: A pig tractor: pigs graze inside an electric fence powered by a small solar panel, with a simple shelter for shade.

english: The ground after the pigs have moved on: they have rooted out the grass and turned the soil, ready for planting.
before: Die grond nadat die varke aangetrek het: hulle het die gras uitgewoel en die grond omgedraai, gereed om te plant.
back_translation: The soil after the pigs have moved on: they rooted up the grass and turned over the soil, ready to plant.

english: Muscovy ducks resting in the shade. They help control pests, graze grass and are much quieter than other ducks.
before: Muskus-eende rus in die skaduwee. Hulle help om plae te beheer, wei gras en is baie stiller as ander eende.
back_translation: Muscovy ducks rest in the shade. They help control pests, graze grass and are much quieter than other ducks.

english: A wooden beehive raised on a stack of old tyres: level, firm and off the damp ground.
before: 'n Houtbyekorf wat op 'n stapel ou bande verhoog is: gelyk, stewig en weg van die klam grond.
back_translation: A wooden beehive raised on a stack of old tyres: level, sturdy and away from the damp ground.

english: A subtropical food forest seen from above: bananas, a young fruit tree, shrubs and groundcover, with no bare soil.
before: 'n Subtropiese voedselwoud van bo af gesien: piesangs, 'n jong vrugteboom, struike en grondbedekking, sonder kaal grond.
back_translation: A subtropical food forest seen from above: bananas, a young fruit tree, shrubs and ground cover, with no bare soil.

english: Quinces: a very frost-hardy fruit for jam and cooking, well suited to cold Highveld and Lesotho winters.
before: Kwepers: 'n baie ryp-bestande vrug vir konfyt en kook, goed geskik vir koue Hoëveld- en Lesotho-winters.
back_translation: Quinces: a very frost-resistant fruit for jam and cooking, well suited to cold Highveld and Lesotho winters.

english: A young peach. Choose a peach variety that matches the winter cold where you live.
before: 'n Jong perske. Kies 'n perskevariëteit wat by die winterkoue waar jy woon pas.
back_translation: A young peach. Choose a peach variety that suits the winter cold where you live.

english: A young apple. Apples need cold winters; in warmer areas choose low-chill varieties.
before: 'n Jong appel. Appels het koue winters nodig; kies in warmer gebiede variëteite met min koue-behoefte.
back_translation: A young apple. Apples need cold winters; in warmer areas choose varieties with a low cold requirement.

english: Mixed cowpea and bean seed, ready to sow as a legume groundcover between young trees.
before: Gemengde akkerboontjie- en boonsaad, gereed om as peulplant-grondbedekking tussen jong bome te saai.
back_translation: Mixed cowpea and bean seed, ready to be sown as a legume ground cover between young trees.

english: Planting basins dug and ready, with the young trees waiting beside them. Dig all the holes and basins before you plant.
before: Plantkomme gegrawe en gereed, met die jong bome wat langs hulle wag. Grawe al die gate en komme voordat jy plant.
back_translation: Planting basins dug and ready, with the young trees waiting beside them. Dig all the holes and basins before you plant.

english: A young lemon tree ringed by pigeon pea. The nitrogen fixers are cut back often and left on the ground as mulch (chop and drop).
before: 'n Jong suurlemoenboom omring deur duiwe-ertjies. Die stikstofbinders word gereeld teruggesny en as deklaag op die grond gelaat (kap en los).
back_translation: A young lemon tree surrounded by pigeon peas. The nitrogen fixers are cut back regularly and left on the ground as mulch (chop and drop).

english: The seven layers of a food forest planted along a swale: tall trees, small trees, shrubs, herbs, roots, groundcover and climbers.
before: Die sewe lae van 'n voedselwoud wat langs 'n kontoersloot geplant is: hoë bome, klein bome, struike, kruie, wortels, grondbedekking en klimmers.
back_translation: The seven layers of a food forest planted along a contour swale: tall trees, small trees, shrubs, herbs, roots, ground cover and climbers.

english: Freshly dug turmeric: a crop for the root layer of a warm, frost-free food forest.
before: Vars uitgegrawe borrie: 'n gewas vir die wortellaag van 'n warm, ryp-vrye voedselwoud.
back_translation: Freshly dug turmeric: a crop for the root layer of a warm, frost-free food forest.

english: Wild dagga (Leonotis leonurus): a fast-growing indigenous windbreak shrub whose orange flowers feed sunbirds.
before: Wildedagga (Leonotis leonurus): 'n vinnig groeiende inheemse windskermstruik waarvan die oranje blomme suikerbekkies voed.
back_translation: Wild dagga (Leonotis leonurus): a fast-growing indigenous windbreak shrub whose orange flowers feed sunbirds.

english: A windbreak of several rows of indigenous trees and shrubs, planted across the damaging wind and kept away from the north side of the garden.
before: 'n Windskerm van verskeie rye inheemse bome en struike, dwars oor die skadelike wind geplant en weg van die noordekant van die tuin gehou.
back_translation: A windbreak of several rows of indigenous trees and shrubs, planted across the harmful wind and kept away from the north side of the garden.

english: A planting hole two to three times as wide as the root ball, with the topsoil and subsoil kept in separate heaps and the stake knocked in first.
before: 'n Plantgat twee tot drie keer so wyd as die wortelkluit, met die bogrond en ondergrond in afsonderlike hope gehou en die paal eerste ingeslaan.
back_translation: A planting hole two to three times as wide as the root ball, with the topsoil and subsoil kept in separate heaps and the stake driven in first.

english: Tying a young tree to its stake. Use a soft tie in a loose figure of eight so the stem can still move a little.
before: 'n Jong boom aan sy paal vasbind. Gebruik 'n sagte band in 'n los agt sodat die stam nog 'n bietjie kan beweeg.
back_translation: Tying a young tree to its stake. Use a soft tie in a loose figure eight so that the trunk can still move a little.

english: An earthworks plan for a whole property: swales, basins and a pond catch runoff from the top of the land to the bottom, each with a safe overflow.
before: 'n Grondwerkeplan vir 'n hele eiendom: kontoerslote, komme en 'n dam vang afloop van bo na onder van die grond op, elk met 'n veilige oorloop.
back_translation: An earthworks plan for a whole property: contour swales, basins and a dam catch runoff from the top to the bottom of the land, each with a safe overflow.

english: A swale full of runoff from a nearby driveway. The water soaks into the soil slowly instead of running away.
before: 'n Kontoersloot vol afloop van 'n nabye oprit. Die water trek stadig in die grond in in plaas daarvan om weg te hardloop.
back_translation: A contour swale full of runoff from a nearby driveway. The water soaks slowly into the ground instead of running away.

english: A long swale being dug by machine, with a survey staff to keep the level true.
before: 'n Lang kontoersloot wat met 'n masjien gegrawe word, met 'n opmetingsstok om die vlak reg te hou.
back_translation: A long contour swale being dug with a machine, with a surveying staff to keep the level right.

english: A recycled drum under a roof downpipe, with a tap near the bottom: a cheap way to start harvesting rainwater. Keep it covered.
before: 'n Herwinde drom onder 'n dakpyp, met 'n kraan naby die bodem: 'n goedkoop manier om reënwater te begin oes. Hou dit bedek.
back_translation: A recycled drum under a roof pipe, with a tap near the bottom: a cheap way to start harvesting rainwater. Keep it covered.

english: Three tanks joined by a pipe at the base, so they fill and empty together.
before: Drie tenks wat by die basis deur 'n pyp verbind is, sodat hulle saam vol- en leegloop.
back_translation: Three tanks connected at the base by a pipe, so that they fill and empty together.

english: Stone-lined channels lead runoff into infiltration basins around young trees, watering them after every rain.
before: Klipbeklede kanale lei afloop na insypelkomme om jong bome, en gee hulle water na elke reën.
back_translation: Stone-lined channels lead runoff to infiltration basins around young trees, and give them water after every rain.

english: A runoff dam at the top of a property catches water flowing down the valley.
before: 'n Afloopdam bo-aan 'n eiendom vang water op wat in die vallei afvloei.
back_translation: A runoff dam at the top of a property catches water that flows down into the valley.

english: Digging a runoff pond with a TLB. Keep people well away from a working machine, and slope the sides of the hole.
before: 'n Afloopdam met 'n TLB grawe. Hou mense ver weg van 'n masjien wat werk, en maak die kante van die gat skuins.
back_translation: A runoff dam being dug with a TLB. Keep people far away from a machine that is working, and make the sides of the hole slanted.

english: The same pond, lined with plastic, a few weeks later, full after heavy rain.
before: Dieselfde dam, 'n paar weke later met plastiek uitgevoer, vol na swaar reën.
back_translation: The same dam, a few weeks later lined with plastic, full after heavy rain.

english: How a sand dam works: a concrete wall is built on bedrock across a dry river bed. Sand builds up behind it and holds water that the sun cannot dry up.
before: Hoe 'n sanddam werk: 'n betonmuur word op rotsbodem dwars oor 'n droë rivierbedding gebou. Sand hoop agter dit op en hou water vas wat die son nie kan opdroog nie.
back_translation: How a sand dam works: a concrete wall is built on bedrock across a dry riverbed. Sand piles up behind it and holds water that the sun cannot dry up.

english: A sand dam across a seasonal river bed.
before: 'n Sanddam dwars oor 'n seisoenale rivierbedding.
back_translation: A sand dam across a seasonal riverbed.

english: An A-frame level: a string with a weight hangs from the top. When the string crosses the centre mark, both legs stand at the same height.
before: 'n A-raamwaterpas: 'n tou met 'n gewig hang van die bokant af. Wanneer die tou die middelmerk kruis, staan albei bene op dieselfde hoogte.
back_translation: An A-frame level: a rope with a weight hangs from the top. When the rope crosses the middle mark, both legs stand at the same height.

english: Pegging out a contour line with an A-frame. Each new peg is at the same height as the one before.
before: 'n Kontoerlyn met 'n A-raam uitpen. Elke nuwe penkie is op dieselfde hoogte as die vorige een.
back_translation: Marking out a contour line with an A-frame using pegs. Each new peg is at the same height as the previous one.

english: Digging a swale by hand along the pegged contour. The soil is piled on the downhill side to make the berm.
before: 'n Kontoersloot met die hand langs die uitgepende kontoer grawe. Die grond word aan die afhelling-kant opgehoop om die wal te maak.
back_translation: A contour swale being dug by hand along the pegged-out contour. The soil is heaped on the downhill side to make the berm.

english: A planted swale and berm: amadumbe in the moist ditch, with lemongrass, sweet potato and pigeon pea on the berm.
before: 'n Beplante kontoersloot en wal: amadumbe in die klam sloot, met sitroengras, patat en duiwe-ertjies op die wal.
back_translation: A planted contour swale and berm: taro in the damp swale, with lemongrass, sweet potato and pigeon peas on the berm.

english: A small vegetable garden prepared by hand by a team of volunteers. With many hands, digging goes quickly.
before: 'n Klein groentetuin wat deur 'n span vrywilligers met die hand voorberei is. Met baie hande gaan die grawe vinnig.
back_translation: A small vegetable garden prepared by hand by a team of volunteers. With many hands the digging goes fast.

english: A two-wheel tractor: small enough for a smallholding, it can plough, rotavate and pull a planter.
before: 'n Tweewieltrekker: klein genoeg vir 'n kleinhoewe, dit kan ploeg, rotavate en 'n planter trek.
back_translation: A two-wheel tractor: small enough for a smallholding, it can plough, rotavate and pull a planter.

english: Black plastic held down with bales and sandbags. Left for some weeks, it kills the grass so that beds can be made without digging.
before: Swart plastiek wat met balle en sandsakke vasgehou word. Vir 'n paar weke gelaat, maak dit die gras dood sodat beddings sonder grawe gemaak kan word.
back_translation: Black plastic held down with bales and sandbags. Left for a few weeks, it kills the grass so that beds can be made without digging.

english: Beds pegged out along the contour on a slope, with the soil pulled downhill to make each bed level.
before: Beddings wat langs die kontoer op 'n helling uitgepen is, met die grond afwaarts getrek om elke bedding gelyk te maak.
back_translation: Beds pegged out along the contour on a slope, with the soil pulled downhill to make each bed level.

english: Double-reach beds edged with stones and filled with good topsoil. Each bed is narrow enough to reach the middle from both sides.
before: Dubbelreik-beddings met klipwande en gevul met goeie bogrond. Elke bedding is smal genoeg om van albei kante tot by die middel te reik.
back_translation: Double-reach beds with stone walls, filled with good topsoil. Each bed is narrow enough to reach to the middle from both sides.

english: A pit bed (banana circle) lined with cardboard and filled with organic matter, being watered. The plants go around the rim.
before: 'n Putbedding (piesangsirkel) met karton uitgevoer en met organiese materiaal gevul, wat natgemaak word. Die plante gaan om die rand.
back_translation: A pit bed (banana circle) lined with cardboard and filled with organic material, which is wetted. The plants go around the edge.

english: Hand watering under shade cloth. Water the soil at the base of the plants, not the leaves.
before: Met die hand natmaak onder skadudoek. Maak die grond aan die voet van die plante nat, nie die blare nie.
back_translation: Wetting by hand under shade cloth. Wet the soil at the base of the plants, not the leaves.

english: Bottle irrigation: an upturned bottle buried beside the plants lets water seep slowly into the roots.
before: Bottelbesproeiing: 'n omgekeerde bottel wat langs die plante begrawe is, laat water stadig na die wortels sypel.
back_translation: Bottle irrigation: an upside-down bottle buried beside the plants lets water seep slowly to the roots.

english: Drip irrigation: the drip line runs past the base of each pepper plant and wets only the soil around its roots.
before: Drupbesproeiing: die druplyn loop verby die voet van elke soetrissieplant en maak net die grond om sy wortels nat.
back_translation: Drip irrigation: the drip line runs past the base of each sweet pepper plant and wets only the soil around its roots.

english: A greywater drum: kitchen water runs through a filter box (grease trap) and on to a mulched swale. Let it flow on the same day; stored greywater goes bad.
before: 'n Gryswaterdrom: kombuiswater loop deur 'n filterkas (vetvanger) en verder na 'n kontoersloot met deklaag. Laat dit dieselfde dag vloei; gestoorde gryswater word sleg.
back_translation: A greywater drum: kitchen water runs through a filter box (grease trap) and onward to a contour swale with mulch. Let it flow on the same day; stored greywater goes bad.

english: The layers of the soil: dark topsoil full of roots and life, lighter subsoil below, and stones and rock at the bottom.
before: Die lae van die grond: donker bogrond vol wortels en lewe, ligter ondergrond daaronder, en klippe en rots onderaan.
back_translation: The layers of the soil: dark topsoil full of roots and life, lighter subsoil beneath it, and stones and rock at the bottom.

english: The jar test: shake soil with water in a clear jar, let it settle for a day, then read the layers of sand, silt and clay.
before: Die flestoets: skud grond met water in 'n deursigtige fles, laat dit 'n dag lank sak, en lees dan die lae sand, slik en klei.
back_translation: The bottle test: shake soil with water in a transparent bottle, let it settle for a day, and then read the layers of sand, silt and clay.

english: A young pumpkin-family seedling growing through straw mulch. The mulch keeps the soil covered, cool and moist.
before: 'n Jong pampoenfamilie-saailing wat deur strooideklaag groei. Die deklaag hou die grond bedek, koel en klam.
back_translation: A young seedling of the pumpkin family growing through straw mulch. The mulch keeps the soil covered, cool and damp.

english: Spreading manure on freshly cut, moist grass: the first layer of a sheet-mulched bed.
before: Mis versprei op vars gesnyde, klam gras: die eerste laag van 'n bedding met laagdeklaag.
back_translation: Manure spread on freshly cut, damp grass: the first layer of a bed with layered mulch (sheet mulch).

english: Sheet mulching: cardboard laid over the grass and covered with compost. The cardboard smothers the grass and then rots away.
before: Laagdeklaag: karton oor die gras gelê en met kompos bedek. Die karton verstik die gras en verrot dan weg.
back_translation: Sheet mulch: cardboard laid over the grass and covered with compost. The cardboard smothers the grass and then rots away.

english: Planting seedlings through a thick layer of straw into the finished sheet-mulched bed.
before: Saailinge deur 'n dik laag strooi in die voltooide bedding met laagdeklaag plant.
back_translation: Planting seedlings through a thick layer of straw in the finished sheet-mulch bed.

english: Building a compost heap on a base of sticks, which lets air in from below.
before: 'n Komposhoop bou op 'n basis van stokke, wat van onder af lug inlaat.
back_translation: A compost heap being built on a base of sticks, which lets air in from below.

english: Watering each layer as the compost heap is built. Keep it about as damp as a wrung-out sponge.
before: Elke laag natmaak soos die komposhoop gebou word. Hou dit ongeveer so klam soos 'n uitgewringde spons.
back_translation: Wet every layer as the compost heap is built. Keep it about as damp as a wrung-out sponge.

english: Red wigglers: the small compost worms used in a worm farm. They are a different kind from ordinary garden earthworms.
before: Rooiwurms: die klein komposwurms wat in 'n wurmplaas gebruik word. Hulle is 'n ander soort as gewone tuinerdwurms.
back_translation: Red worms: the small compost worms used in a worm farm. They are a different kind from ordinary garden earthworms.

english: An old bath on bricks used as a worm farm, with a hessian cover to keep it dark and moist.
before: 'n Ou bad op bakstene wat as wurmplaas gebruik word, met 'n goiingsak-deksel om dit donker en klam te hou.
back_translation: An old bath on bricks used as a worm farm, with a hessian-sack lid to keep it dark and damp.

english: A stacking worm farm: the worms move up into the top tray of fresh food, and worm tea drains out at the bottom.
before: 'n Stapelbare wurmplaas: die wurms beweeg op na die boonste laai met vars kos, en wurmtee dreineer onderaan uit.
back_translation: A stackable worm farm: the worms move up to the top drawer with fresh food, and worm tea drains out at the bottom.

english: The ecological pyramid: many plants at the base, fewer plant-eaters above them, fewer predators again, and only a few top predators such as owls.
before: Die ekologiese piramide: baie plante onderaan, minder plantvreters daarbo, weer minder roofdiere, en net 'n paar topvleisvreters soos uile.
back_translation: The ecological pyramid: many plants at the bottom, fewer plant-eaters above, even fewer predators, and only a few top meat-eaters such as owls.

english: A dense cowpea groundcover. As a pioneer legume it covers bare soil, feeds it with nitrogen and gives food as well.
before: 'n Digte akkerboontjie-grondbedekking. As pionier-peulplant bedek dit kaal grond, voed dit met stikstof en gee ook kos.
back_translation: A dense cowpea ground cover. As a pioneer legume it covers bare soil, feeds it with nitrogen and also gives food.

english: Pioneers first: pigeon pea and indigenous sweet thorn growing between young fruit trees to feed the soil.
before: Pioniers eerste: duiwe-ertjie en inheemse soetdoring groei tussen jong vrugtebome om die grond te voed.
back_translation: Pioneers first: pigeon pea and indigenous sweet thorn grow between young fruit trees to feed the soil.

english: Filling a small wildlife pond edged with stones. Frogs and dragonflies soon move in.
before: 'n Klein wildlewe-dammetjie met klippe as rand vul. Paddas en naaldekokers trek gou in.
back_translation: Filling a small wildlife pond with stones as the edge. Frogs and dragonflies move in soon.

english: A barn owl box on a pole at least 3 m above the ground. A family of barn owls can eat 1 000 or more rodents a year.
before: 'n Nes-kas vir nonnetjie-uile op 'n paal minstens 3 m bo die grond. 'n Familie nonnetjie-uile kan 1 000 of meer knaagdiere per jaar eet.
back_translation: A nest box for barn owls on a pole at least 3 m above the ground. A family of barn owls can eat 1 000 or more rodents per year.

english: Cabbages with marigolds, nasturtiums and borage between them. The mixed flowers feed useful insects and help hide the cabbages from pests.
before: Kool met afrikaners, kappertjies en komkommerkruid daartussen. Die gemengde blomme voed nuttige insekte en help om die kool vir plae te verberg.
back_translation: Cabbage with marigolds, nasturtiums (or capers?) and borage between them. The mixed flowers feed useful insects and help to hide the cabbage from pests.
note: 'kappertjie' can also mean caper, so the blind back-translation hedged; it is the nasturtium word the Afrikaans chapters use (kappertjie (nasturtium)). Kept.

english: Nasturtium as a trap crop: aphids gather on its leaves instead of on the cabbages. Pick the infested leaves and feed them to the chickens.
before: Kappertjie as lokgewas: plantluise versamel op sy blare in plaas van op die kool. Pluk die besmette blare en voer dit aan die hoenders.
back_translation: Nasturtium (or caper?) as a trap crop: aphids collect on its leaves instead of on the cabbage. Pick the infested leaves and feed them to the chickens.
note: Same as the companion-flowers caption: 'Kappertjie' is the chapters' word for nasturtium. Kept.

english: Onions planted along the edge of a carrot bed: good neighbours in the garden.
before: Uie wat langs die rand van 'n worteelbedding geplant is: goeie bure in die tuin.
back_translation: Onions planted along the edge of a carrot(?)/root bed: good neighbours in the garden.
after: Uie wat langs die rand van 'n geelwortelbedding geplant is: goeie bure in die tuin.
note: 'worteelbedding' is not a word and reads as a root bed; the English is a carrot bed. Now 'geelwortelbedding', using the glossary and chapter word 'geelwortel' for carrot.

english: A stone-and-cob building with solar panels and a roof vent: a home designed for the sun.
before: 'n Klip-en-kleigebou met sonpanele en 'n dakopening: 'n huis wat vir die son ontwerp is.
back_translation: A stone-and-clay building with solar panels and a roof opening: a house designed for the sun.

english: Two small solar panels on a tin roof: enough for LED lights and charging phones.
before: Twee klein sonpanele op 'n sinkdak: genoeg vir LED-ligte en om selfone te laai.
back_translation: Two small solar panels on a zinc roof: enough for LED lights and to charge cell phones.

english: An evacuated-tube solar geyser on a roof. Like solar panels, it should face north.
before: 'n Sonkrag-geiser met vakuumbuise op 'n dak. Soos sonpanele moet dit noord kyk.
back_translation: A solar geyser with vacuum tubes on a roof. Like solar panels it must face north.

english: A box solar cooker with a pot of stew. Use thick gloves: the pot and the box get very hot.
before: 'n Kassonkoker met 'n pot bredie. Gebruik dik handskoene: die pot en die kas word baie warm.
back_translation: A box solar cooker with a pot of stew. Use thick gloves: the pot and the box get very hot.

english: Halved fruit drying on corrugated iron. Dry food off the ground, cover it with netting against flies and bring it in at night.
before: Gehalveerde vrugte wat op sinkplaat droog. Droog kos van die grond af, bedek dit met net teen vlieë en bring dit snags in.
back_translation: Halved fruit drying on sheet metal. Dry food off the ground, cover it with netting against flies and bring it in at night.

english: A solar dryer with a glass lid: food dries faster and stays clean, safe from flies and dust.
before: 'n Sondroër met 'n glasdeksel: kos droog vinniger en bly skoon, veilig teen vlieë en stof.
back_translation: A solar dryer with a glass lid: food dries faster and stays clean, safe from flies and dust.

english: A wonder bag. Bring the pot to the boil on the stove, then put it in the bag to finish cooking without more fuel.
before: 'n Wonderbag. Bring die pot op die stoof tot kookpunt, sit dit dan in die sak om sonder meer brandstof klaar te kook.
back_translation: A wonder bag. Bring the pot on the stove to boiling point, then put it in the bag to finish cooking without more fuel.

english: A rocket stove cut away to show inside: sticks burn at the base of a short, insulated chimney, so the fire is hot and uses little wood.
before: 'n Vuurpylstoof oopgesny om binnekant te wys: stokke brand onderaan 'n kort, geïsoleerde skoorsteen, so die vuur is warm en gebruik min hout.
back_translation: A rocket stove cut open to show the inside: sticks burn at the bottom of a short, insulated chimney, so the fire is hot and uses little wood.

english: How a household biogas digester works: manure and food waste go in, gas flows to the kitchen stove, and the slurry goes to the garden.
before: Hoe 'n huishoudelike biogasverteerder werk: mis en kosafval gaan in, gas vloei na die kombuisstoof, en die slyk gaan na die tuin.
back_translation: How a household biogas digester works: manure and food waste go in, gas flows to the kitchen stove, and the slurry/sludge goes to the garden.

english: Building a household biogas digester: the tank sits in a block-lined pit.
before: 'n Huishoudelike biogasverteerder bou: die tenk sit in 'n put met blokmure.
back_translation: Building a household biogas digester: the tank sits in a pit with block walls.

english: A finished household biogas digester, with the gas pipe running to the kitchen. Biogas can explode: keep flames away from leaks and let fresh air in.
before: 'n Voltooide huishoudelike biogasverteerder, met die gaspyp wat na die kombuis loop. Biogas kan ontplof: hou vlamme weg van lekke en laat vars lug in.
back_translation: A finished household biogas digester, with the gas pipe running to the kitchen. Biogas can explode: keep flames away from leaks and let fresh air in.

english: What are you preparing?
before: Wat berei jy voor?
back_translation: What are you preparing?

english: Choose the purpose, then the questionnaire length. Your maps and production plan remain linked to this site.
before: Kies die doel, kies dan die lengte van die vraelys. Jou kaarte en produksieplan bly aan hierdie terrein gekoppel.
back_translation: Choose the purpose, then choose the length of the questionnaire. Your maps and production plan stay linked to this site.

english: Understand the site, constraints and possibilities before detailed design.
before: Verstaan die terrein, beperkings en moontlikhede voor gedetailleerde ontwerp.
back_translation: Understand the site, limitations and possibilities before detailed design.

english: Bring the site survey, saved maps and whole-year production plan together. Missing evidence stays visible.
before: Bring die terreinopname, gestoorde kaarte en die hele jaar se produksieplan bymekaar. Ontbrekende bewyse bly sigbaar.
back_translation: Bring the site survey, stored maps and the whole year's production plan together. Missing evidence stays visible.

english: Share this summary with funders
before: Deel hierdie opsomming met befondsers
back_translation: Share this summary with funders.
